Picture, controller, touchpad and mod settings of the PS5 port.

group.name: PS5Options
group.str: Picture
Resolution, refresh rate, frame rate and quality.
Controller and touchpad
How the touchpad, the buttons and note timing work.
Mods
The online mod browser, installed mods and the download cache.
About this port
Shows the notice again: this is an unofficial, AI-made port.
Support Codename Engine
Opens codename-engine.com in the PS5's browser. Play it on PC to support its developers!
Source code of the port
Opens the port's GitHub page, where bugs of the port can be reported.
Resolution
The size the game draws at. Applies the next time the game starts. 4K draws four times as many pixels as 1080p.
Refresh rate
120 Hz needs a TV that supports it. Applies the next time the game starts.
V-Sync
Waits for the TV before each frame: no tearing, but up to one frame more input delay. Off by default.
Frame rate
How many times a second the game updates and draws. Higher means less input delay.
Current picture
The game started at {0}, {1} Hz.
Touchpad moves the pointer
Slide a finger on the touchpad to move the mouse pointer, and click it to click. For the editors and menus.
Pointer speed
How far the pointer moves for a slide on the touchpad.
Touchpad opens the chart editor
Clicking the touchpad during a song opens the chart editor on that song.
Button hints
Shows which button does what at the bottom of the main menu.
Notes: D-pad and sticks, or square cross triangle circle
Left, down, up, right on the D-pad or either stick; or square, cross, triangle, circle. OPTIONS pauses. A USB keyboard works as on PC.
Mod browser
Browse and download mods from GameBanana and Game Jolt.
Installed mods
Play, inspect or delete the mods in the mods folder.
Show mods with content ratings
GameBanana marks some mods for violence, language or other mature content. They are hidden unless this is on.
Clear the download cache
Deletes cached pictures and unfinished downloads. Installed mods are kept.
Mods folder
Mods are kept in {0}. You can copy mods there over FTP too.
